description: This file defines the StateDictStager class, which handles optimized staging of PyTorch storage objects and tensors during checkpointing, including memory sharing and pinning strategies for efficient CPU-GPU data transfer.

classes.name: StateDictStager
classes.description: A class for optimizing storage objects during staging for async checkpointing, with memory sharing and pinning capabilities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the StateDictStager with options for pinning memory, sharing memory, and minimum size for pinning.

methods.name: _stage_untyped_storage
methods.description: Handles the caching and creation of CPU storage for a given storage object, with optional memory pinning.

methods.name: stage
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the state_dict with tensor offloading and storage optimization.

methods.name: _offload_tensor
methods.description: Creates a CPU copy of a tensor with optimized storage handling, including sharing and pinning.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Clears cached storages and releases resources.

methods.name: deepcopy_with_tensor_offload
methods.description: Deep copies arbitrary Python objects with special handling for PyTorch tensors and storages, applying memory sharing and pinning.

methods.name: _keep_alive
methods.description: Maintains references to objects to prevent premature garbage collection during deep copy.

methods.name: _reconstruct
methods.description: Reconstructs objects during deep copy, handling states, attributes, and nested structures.
